rows.label: tlk70000003_02_msg0001
rows.name:
The hats we made together have been a
huge hit since then, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000003_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Now all the Nopon children in town
wear them, and Tekuteku is very happy,
mo!

rows.label: tlk70000003_02_msg0003
rows.name:
I looked confident then, but actually
I was a little worried, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000003_02_msg0004
rows.name:
But thanks to all of you and the shop
owner working with me, those worries
disappeared, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000003_02_msg0005
rows.name:
That's why Tekuteku had so much fun,
mo! Thank you, mo!
